title: TrustedRouter, which raised $6M to offer E2EE and confidential computing for enterprise AI queries, says it processes 6B+ tokens per day, up from 1B in August (Davey Alba/Bloomberg)
summary: Davey Alba / Bloomberg: TrustedRouter, which raised $6M to offer E2EE and confidential computing for enterprise AI queries, says it processes 6B+ tokens per day, up from 1B in August — The startup offers companies a way to keep employees' AI use private from model makers … Tech Across the Globe
